svg.text: Original Prusa i3 MK3S → FYSETC Cheetah V3.0
Where every cable plugs in (firmware: pio run -e MK3S_CHEETAH_V3). Simplified layout: positions are approximate, go by the names printed on the board.
MCU: step PC0, dir PC1, enable PC3.
MCU: step PC14, dir PC13, enable PC15.
Left and right Z motor on the two Z
connectors (one driver, as on the EINSy).
FYSETC NEMA 14 on the BMG 3:1 extruder.

Jumpers to set (amber on the board)
X, Y, Z DIAG: installed (sensorless homing, crash detection).
Fan voltage of FAN0 and FAN1 (5 / 12 / 24): on 5.
B0 (boot): on G for normal use; on 3V3 only to flash.
PSU + and − to the power input terminals.
Check the polarity printed on the board.
Both bed wires to the Heated-Bed terminals
To the E0 heater terminals (MCU PC7).
FAN0, voltage jumper on 5. Red = +, black = −.
FAN2, X-MIN, Y-MIN, Z-MIN, EXP3 and the PSU
power panic cable are not used. Nothing may be
plugged into X/Y/Z-MIN with the DIAG jumpers on.

Use the slot of the LCD or this one,
not both at once (same SPI bus).

The two flat cables of the original LCD:
P1 → EXP1, P2 → EXP2. Check the orientation
(EXP1 pin 1 = 5 V, pin 2 = GND): a wrong
way round shows a blank or garbled screen.
Probe connector: signal, 5 V, GND (MCU PA0).
5 V for the sensor from the RGB (Neopixel)
signal wire, band toward the sensor.
Raspberry Pi header UART, no Pi needed:
RX1 (PA10) ← MMU TX through a divider:
1 kΩ in series, 2 kΩ to GND (MMU is 5 V)
GND ↔ GND. MMU power from the PSU.
